There are always more possibilities than we expect. Tom and Ben are preparing a report about the bus terminal. People around Ben often share different ideas about the bus terminal. In fact, a voucher came as a goodwill gesture.
On Saturday evenings, Ben reviews the notes from class. Ben wrote down every idea in a small notebook. Ben usually spends the weekend reading at the bookstore. Dispatch takes up to two days.
Ben keeps a small cat at home and feeds it every morning. Ben thanked Tom for the honest advice. Ben believes that trying new things keeps life fresh. Also, wear and tear is not covered.

What matters most is not speed, but keeping on. Tom always says that small steps matter more than big plans. Sometimes a short talk can solve a big problem. In fact, the neighbouring countries signed a trade agreement last week.
At first, Ben found it difficult to keep the habit. There is still a long way to go, but the direction is right. They talked about everything from schoolwork to future dreams.
